name: UpdateDeviceGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the device label. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported. Spaces are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 设备标签名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不支持空格
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the device label. If you pass in an empty string, the description is cleared. The description can contain letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 设备标签描述。传入空字符串时清空描述。支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、空格、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the device label
parameters.name: device_group_id

parameters.help_en: The rule operator of the dynamic device group
parameters.name: dynamic_operator
